arkansas_now.label: ARKANSAS NOW
arkansas_now.question: What role does this county actually play in Arkansas' present political-economic system?

cc_future.label: CC FUTURE
cc_future.question: Given its people, assets, geography, capabilities, constraints and relationships with surrounding counties, what functions could this county realistically perform in a more prosperous Arkansas?
cc_future.rule: Identify possibilities and pathways — never decide that a county must become something.

dimensions.label: Household Prosperity
dimensions.question: Income, housing, costs, poverty, ownership proxies, economic pressure

dimensions.label: Human Capability
dimensions.question: Schools, credentials, trades, colleges, skills, health

dimensions.label: Ownership & Capital
dimensions.question: Local businesses, farms, major employers, financial access, productive assets

dimensions.label: Infrastructure
dimensions.question: Roads, rail, broadband, power, water, logistics

dimensions.label: Government & Public Money
dimensions.question: Local revenue, expenditures, state/federal dependence, public assets

dimensions.label: Connectivity
dimensions.question: Where residents work/shop/study/receive care; county relationships

dimensions.label: Resilience
dimensions.question: Concentration, population loss, disaster, employer/federal dependence

balance_sheet.note: Metabolism of the county — not a complete audited cash-flow statement.

geographic_money_statement.rule: Show KNOWN / ESTIMATED / PROXY / UNKNOWN. Do not fabricate precision.

opportunity_portfolio.forbidden_publication: The future of County X is [single industry].
opportunity_portfolio.philosophy: The system identifies opportunity; people and markets still decide what actually emerges.

network.label: THE ARKANSAS COUNTY NETWORK
example_graph_questions: Which counties depend on the same hospital?
Where does electricity originate versus get consumed?
Which counties depend disproportionately on one employer?
Where does broadband weakness constrain otherwise viable development?
Where could several counties share infrastructure rather than duplicating it?

map_data_contract.interaction: Full-screen Arkansas map → choose layer → click county → County X-Ray.

field_first_pipeline.rule: Populate one field across all 75 before deepening interpretation.
field_first_pipeline.later: Remaining dimensions field-first; network edges; balance sheets; portfolios

decomposition_rule.text: Every baseline object capable of geographic decomposition must be evaluated for State → Region → County applicability. Not every metric needs county data. Every major system must ask whether geography materially changes the answer.
